signals.label: FAA Inbound Delay
signals.note: FAA-declared delay for flights into SFO. Ground Delay Program: flights are held at their origin and given metered departure times. Delay: average 67m, worst 135m. Cause: low ceilings.

signals.label: FAA Outbound Delay
signals.note: FAA-declared delay for flights out of SFO.

signals.label: Drive to T1
signals.note: TomTom live-traffic drive time from the configured origin to the Terminal 1 curb. Free-flow is ~10m; the difference is traffic.

signals.label: FAA Inbound Delay
signals.note: FAA-declared delay for flights into SEA.

signals.label: FAA Outbound Delay
signals.note: FAA-declared delay for flights out of SEA. Delay: worst 30m, from 16m. Cause: volume, compacted demand. Rising/Falling is the FAA's own read on whether that delay is growing or winding down.

signals.label: Drive to SEA
signals.note: TomTom live-traffic drive time from the configured origin to the SEA departures curb. Free-flow is ~27m; the difference is traffic.
